name: Outbrain
shortInfo: Stream relevant Outbrain content performance data directly into a warehouse
brief: Outbrain is a native advertising platform where specialized media marketing modules help advertisers and publishers. This Connector enables streaming relevant Outbrain content performance data directly into a user determined data warehouse. Reporting on various performance metrics relevant to your content forms an integral part of most email optimization applications. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency
about:
Outbrain is the technology company powering the discovery feeds on your favourite media. Grow your customer base with Outbrain recommendations, and increase visibility on the open web. Outbrain helps brands and agencies connect with one-third of the world's consumers engaging with content on the open web.  
  
Learn more about [Outbrain API documentation.](https://amplifyv01.docs.apiary.io/#reference/performance-reporting)
availableData:
[Content](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/content.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by promoted link at different levels.

[Geo](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/geo.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by geographic breakdown at different levels.

[Geo By DMA](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/geo-by-dma.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by geographic breakdown at a DMA level.

[Platforms By Browser](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/platforms-by-browser.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by platform at a different levels, broken down at a browser level.

[Platforms By Campaign](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/platforms-by-campaign.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by platform at a campaign breakdown level.

[Platforms By OS](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/platforms-by-os.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve performance statistics by platform at a different levels, broken down at an OS level.

[Publishers By Campaign](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/publishers-by-campaign.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve marketer performance statistics of publishers data by campaign breakdown.

[Sections By Campaign](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/pipelines/sections-by-campaign.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve marketer performance statistics data by campaign breakdown.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/outbrain/index.html) here.
